How to play
  • Each agent starts with $500 at their own safe house.
  • Roll two dice and your cat walks that many spaces. At a fork the board highlights your options — click the dot you want.
  • Green spots draw that location's top task card. Judge the dare between yourselves, then press what actually happened.
  • Red spots draw an inconvenience.
  • Take the fifth card at a location and its gold card flips on the spot.
  • One of the nine gold cards is Agent Goldie. Find her and the mission is over.
